title: CRISPR-based gene editing system for targeted therapeutic modification
abstract: A method for editing genomic sequences using a guide RNA and Cas9 nuclease to achieve precise therapeutic modifications in mammalian cells with reduced off-target effects.
claims: A method comprising: providing a guide RNA targeting a specific genomic locus; introducing a Cas9 nuclease; and modifying the target sequence to alter gene expression.

title: Novel kinase inhibitor compounds for oncology treatment
abstract: Pharmaceutical compositions containing substituted pyrimidine derivatives that selectively inhibit kinase activity for treatment of solid tumors and hematological malignancies.
claims: A pharmaceutical composition comprising a compound of formula I and a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier, wherein the compound inhibits kinase activity at sub-micromolar concentrations.

title: High-efficiency perovskite solar cell with stabilized interface
abstract: A photovoltaic device incorporating a perovskite absorber layer with an engineered electron transport layer that improves power conversion efficiency and long-term stability under ambient conditions.
claims: A solar cell comprising: a perovskite absorber layer; an electron transport layer comprising a metal oxide nanoparticle film; and a hole transport layer configured to minimize interfacial recombination.

title: Transformer-based neural network for molecular property prediction
abstract: A deep learning system using self-attention mechanisms to predict molecular binding affinity, toxicity, and synthesis feasibility from SMILES representations without hand-crafted descriptors.
claims: A computer-implemented method comprising: encoding molecular structures as token sequences; processing the sequences through a transformer architecture; and outputting predicted molecular properties.

title: Continuous flow catalytic reactor for green chemistry synthesis
abstract: An apparatus and method for continuous flow chemical synthesis using immobilized heterogeneous catalysts to reduce waste and improve reaction yield in pharmaceutical intermediate production.
claims: A reactor system comprising: a flow channel containing immobilized catalyst particles; a temperature control module; and a product separation unit integrated in a single continuous process line.

title: Antibody-drug conjugate targeting HER2-positive cancers
abstract: Conjugates linking cytotoxic payloads to monoclonal antibodies that bind HER2 receptors, enabling targeted delivery to breast and gastric cancer cells with improved therapeutic index.
claims: An antibody-drug conjugate comprising: an anti-HER2 antibody; a cleavable linker; and a cytotoxic agent attached via the linker at a drug-to-antibody ratio of 2 to 8.

title: Quantum dot display with enhanced color gamut
abstract: A display device utilizing engineered quantum dots embedded in a polymer matrix to achieve wide color gamut and high luminance efficiency for next-generation visual displays.
claims: A display comprising: a blue LED backlight; a quantum dot conversion layer with red and green emitting dots; and an optical filter configured to pass converted emission while blocking excitation light.

title: Federated learning framework for privacy-preserving medical AI
abstract: A distributed machine learning system enabling hospitals to collaboratively train diagnostic models without sharing raw patient data, using encrypted gradient aggregation and differential privacy.
claims: A method comprising: training local models at multiple institutions on private data; aggregating model updates via secure multi-party computation; and distributing an updated global model without exposing raw records.

title: Solid-state battery electrolyte with lithium ion conductivity
abstract: A ceramic-polymer composite electrolyte achieving high lithium ion conductivity at room temperature for use in next-generation solid-state energy storage devices.
claims: An electrolyte layer comprising: a lithium-conducting ceramic phase dispersed in a polymer matrix; wherein the composite exhibits ionic conductivity exceeding 1 mS/cm at 25 degrees Celsius.

title: Microfluidic device for single-cell RNA sequencing
abstract: A lab-on-chip platform that captures individual cells in microdroplets and performs reverse transcription and barcoding for high-throughput single-cell transcriptomic analysis.
claims: A microfluidic device comprising: a droplet generation junction; cell capture chambers; and integrated reagent channels for barcoded reverse transcription of RNA from isolated single cells.
